teacherNotes.title: Core Words
teacherNotes.content: kind, friendly, funny, quiet, serious, polite, patient, intelligent, active, cheerful, honest

elements.content: Core Active Vocabulary (10-20 items):
kind, friendly, funny, quiet, serious, polite, patient, intelligent, active, cheerful, honest
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• What is he like? (asking character)
• He is very kind and patient (describing traits)
• She can be a bit quiet (mitigating negative/neutral trait)
• My friend is really funny (expressing strong impression)

teacherNotes.title: Phonetic Focus
teacherNotes.content: Intonation in balanced sentences with 'and' / 'but'. Word stress in 'patient', 'intelligent'.

elements.content: Pronunciation Focus:
Intonation in balanced sentences with 'and' / 'but'. Word stress in 'patient', 'intelligent'.
Grammar System & Functional Framing:
Verb 'be' + Modifiers 'very', 'a bit', 'quite' + Connectors 'and', 'but'
Controlled Practice:
She likes helping everyone and smiling. How is she?
Reading Script & Dialogue:

A: What is your sister like?
B: She is very friendly and active, but she can be a bit quiet with strangers.
A: Is she helpful?
B: Yes, she is always ready to help.
Listen to people describing their best friends' character and note positive and neutral traits.
